title: Catalog Ingestion Capability
description: Seller-wide ingestion contract for buyer-managed catalogs sent through sync_catalogs. Presence in media_buy.features requires catalog_management: true. A seller MUST reject an unlisted catalog type, ingestion mode, feed format, or explicitly supplied content_id_type outside a declared supported_content_id_types list with UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE before mutation, including on dry runs. A missing declaration means support is unknown, not unrestricted. Product catalog_types remains authoritative for serving eligibility.

accepted_catalog_types.description: Catalog types accepted by sync_catalogs. The agent-wide union of product catalog_types; accepting a type does not mean every product can serve it.

ingestion_modes.description: Supported catalog sources: feed_url fetches Catalog.url; inline_items accepts Catalog.items. Catalog references without either field are not a new ingestion mode.

supported_feed_formats.description: External feed formats the seller parses. Required when feed_url is supported; an empty list means no external formats are accepted. Native AdCP offering feeds omit feed_format and are governed by accepted_catalog_types and ingestion_modes. custom uses the existing buyer-supplied feed_field_mappings contract.

supported_content_id_types.description: Identifier types the seller can key catalog items by for conversion matching. When declared, an explicitly supplied Catalog.content_id_type MUST be listed. An empty list accepts none of the named types. Absence leaves identifier support unknown; buyers using custom identifiers continue to omit content_id_type.

max_inline_items_per_request.description: Maximum total number of inline items across all catalogs in one sync_catalogs request. Applicable only with inline_items support. A seller MUST reject excess items with INVALID_REQUEST before mutation. Absence means the limit is unknown, not unlimited.

item_status_reporting.description: per_item: terminal results for created, updated, or unchanged catalogs MUST include exactly one catalogs[].item_issues entry for every item in the resulting catalog, including approved and pending items, with its canonical item_id and catalog-item-status. This includes discovery-only reads of accessible buyer-managed catalogs, which MUST return current statuses without re-ingestion or restarting review. The number of unique item_id entries MUST equal item_count. Buyers use a fresh idempotency_key for each current read; replayed results are historical snapshots. feed_level: only catalog/feed registration is confirmed, without complete item outcomes. Neither mode guarantees that every item is approved; feed_level does not prove a fetched revision. Dry-run statuses are previews, not live eligibility.
